newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO'S GEUPEC TO PAY TV AZTECA SHARES.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO'S GEUPEC TO PAY TV AZTECA SHARES.

text.p: Mexican bottler Grupo Embotelladoras Unidas SA de CV (Geupec) announced late Thursday that it will pay a dividend in the shares Geupec holds in broadcaster TV Azteca.
"A dividend of 150,631,772 pesos in kind was agreed at the annual meeting...which are our shares in TV Azteca," Geupec director general Idelfonso Ochoa Martinez told Reuters in a telephone interview.
The dividend in kind will be paid out to the holders of Geupec's 54,829,778 shares in circulation and is equivalent to 2.7473 pesos per share, he added.
Ochoa Martinez explained that Geupec held 30,264,497 Azteca shares, amounting to 1.5 percent of the country's second largest television chain, which will go public next Thursday.
It will be paid to those who hold Geupec shares at the close of trading on the Mexican Stock Exchange on August 12. The dividend in kind will be paid from August 15.

Geupec is a franchise holder of PepsiCo Inc, producing the distributing seven PepsiCo soft drink brands, as well as three own brands in the western states of Jalisco, Michoacan, Guanajuato, Colima y Nayarit.
